name: Mu2e
notes: No physics results exist yet: every fetched status source describes Mu2e as still under construction/installation, with data collection not yet begun (most recently planned for 2027). This is stated explicitly rather than left to silence, per the correctness rule that an incomplete/no-results state must never be implied by omission.

Sensitivity-goal conflict: the INSPIRE experiment record (closest to the original approved proposal) states 2.5×10⁻¹⁷; a 2022 Mu2e collaboration status proceedings paper states 3×10⁻¹⁷ for a staged Run-1+Run-2 plan. Both are recorded (primary value 2.5×10⁻¹⁷, the other noted) rather than silently picking one.

A documented lineage exists to the cancelled Brookhaven proposal MECO (Muon-to-Electron COnversion); no source describing this lineage was consulted, so it is not recorded here rather than asserted from memory.

physics_goals.quote: The muon-to-electron conversion experiment (Mu2e) is designed to search for the coherent, neutrino-less conversion of a muon to an electron, in the Coulomb field of a nucleus with a single event sensitivity of about 2.5 x 10^-17.
physics_goals.value: Search for charged-lepton-flavor-violating, neutrino-less conversion of a muon to an electron in the field of an aluminum nucleus (μ⁻ N → e⁻ N), a process forbidden in the Standard Model

summary.plain: An experiment being built at Fermilab that will look for a muon turning directly into an electron without any neutrinos -- something the standard laws of particle physics say should never happen. Construction is under way; no data has been taken yet.
summary.technical: Fermilab E973 (Mu2e): searches for coherent, neutrino-less μ⁻ N → e⁻ N conversion in the field of an aluminum nucleus using a pulsed muon beam and a 25 m chain of three superconducting solenoids (production, transport, detector) feeding a straw-tube tracker, crystal calorimeter and cosmic-ray veto. Proposed 2008, approved 2010, CD-3 construction approval June 2016; as of the most recently fetched status report (2026-07) construction/installation is ongoing across all subsystems with initial data collection planned for 2027. No physics results have been produced yet.

unique_capabilities.quote: The system comprises production, transport, and detector solenoids, with downstream straw tracker and crystal calorimeter.
unique_capabilities.value: A 25-metre chain of three superconducting solenoids (production, transport, detector) that curves and momentum-selects the muon beam to suppress prompt background before the electrons reach the tracker and calorimeter
